payload.description: Browse the looks your Agent has worn and switch their avatar in one click, or go back to the original. Outfits keeps a history of the avatar pictures (called looks) your Agent has worn and lets you switch between them. Click the avatar in the Nova chat to open the list, choose a look, or return to the Base avatar. It does not draw pictures by itself: new looks come from your Agent, who can make them with ComfyUI and save them here.
